title: 📊 User Experience & Web Vitals
description: Page load performance, Core Web Vitals (CLS, LCP, FID, FCP, TTFB), and navigation timing for the football statistics frontend.

queries.sql: select round(avg(metric_value), 0) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='metric' and metric_name='web_vital_ttfb'
select round(avg(metric_value), 0) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='metric' and metric_name='web_vital_lcp'
select round(avg(metric_value), 0) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='metric' and metric_name='web_vital_fcp'
select round(avg(metric_value), 3) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='metric' and metric_name='web_vital_cls'

select histogram(_timestamp) as zo_sql_key, metric_name, round(avg(metric_value), 1) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='metric' and metric_name like 'web_vital_%' group by zo_sql_key, metric_name order by zo_sql_key
select metric_name, round(avg(metric_value), 1) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='metric' and metric_name like 'web_vital_%' group by metric_name order by zo_sql_num desc
select metric_name, round(avg(metric_value), 1) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='metric' and metric_name like 'page_load_%' group by metric_name order by metric_name

select histogram(_timestamp) as zo_sql_key, metric_name, round(avg(metric_value), 1) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='metric' and metric_name like 'page_load_%' group by zo_sql_key, metric_name order by zo_sql_key
select page, count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='page_view' group by page order by zo_sql_num desc
select histogram(_timestamp) as zo_sql_key, count(*) as zo_sql_num from "web_events" where event_type='page_view' group by zo_sql_key order by zo_sql_key
select referrer, count(*) as visits from "web_events" where event_type='page_view' and referrer is not null and referrer != '' group by referrer order by visits desc
select previous_page, page, count(*) as navigations from "web_events" where event_type='page_view' and previous_page is not null group by previous_page, page order by navigations desc limit 20
